ads._doc: Interstitial: only when the player taps NEXT after this many finished levels; never mid-level, never first session, never with Remove Ads.

story._novel_doc: A level's story scene plays only if the level brings something the campaign has not shown before: a hero, a mechanism kind, a material, one of these gadget shapes, a captive, bolts, an engineer or a boss (Data.novelty).

crush._doc: A released rope load (and wrecking balls/cages) smashes what it lands on: damage = speed * damage_per_speed to each block/archer it touches while faster than min_speed.

currencies._doc: Wallet: coins (earned, spent on engines/upgrades) and gems (premium, almost only from purchases). Premium rewards only on first clears.

lever._doc: Lever switch: any shot, moving block or blast flips it and fires its triggers.

rotor._doc: Windmill arms / orbiting shield plates (rotating kinematic body). Hub hit jams a windmill.

rune_switch._doc: Hidden switch inside the fortress; glows once no block covers it.

trapdoor._doc: Floor panel on a hinge; opens when triggered so what stands on it falls.

boss_rig._doc: Boss stages (src/game/boss_rig.gd): cores shield the boss, cannons shoot soldiers, engineers rebuild.

special_pack._doc: Master Sieges: ten hard fixed-loadout mechanic puzzles shown on Challenges, unlocked by campaign stars.

siege_weapons._doc: Distinct siege engines. Level requirement reveals the engine; unlock_cost buys it. Track effects are real multipliers applied by Progression.

catapult.name: Royal Catapult
catapult.desc: Reliable arcs. Torsion power and a reinforced cup make every direct hit count.

ballista.name: Ironbolt Ballista
ballista.desc: A low, fast shot for front walls and iron. Its rail sacrifices blast size for direct damage.

trebuchet.name: War Trebuchet
trebuchet.desc: A towering counterweight engine. Slow to reload, but its heavy lob amplifies every ability.

upgrades._doc: Vanguard tracks. Siege-engine tracks live under siege_weapons.<id>.tracks and cost coins only.

cosmetics._doc: Looks only, never stronger. price {coins|gems}; source shown when locked.

sakura.name: Sakura Shrine
sakura.description: A curved shrine canopy, flower hubs and living cherry branches.

desert_gold.name: Sunforged
desert_gold.description: A radiant sun shield with plated fenders and a scorpion-tail crest.

pirate.name: Dread Corsair
pirate.description: A black sail, rope netting and an anchor-braced siege deck.

forge.name: Magma Foundry
forge.description: Armored plating, exhaust stacks and molten channels turn it into a rolling forge.

royal.name: King's Parade
royal.description: A crowned blue-and-gold war machine with shields and ceremonial banners.

sky.name: Stormwing
sky.description: Feathered wings, cloud vanes and a lightning cradle make it look ready to fly.

shadow.name: Night Wraith
shadow.description: Bat-wing armor, violet runes and a hooded cradle reshape the whole machine.

realm_chests._doc: Per realm, claimable on the map at these star counts.

secrets._doc: One hidden map scroll per realm (a crate with decor 'scroll'). Finding it unlocks that realm's secret level.

daily._doc: 7-day login calendar (src/ui/daily_rewards.gd). Missing a day does not reset the streak.

spin._doc: Spin wheel (src/ui/spin_wheel.gd). First spin each day free, then up to ads_per_day with a rewarded ad. weight = relative odds.

shop._doc: Play Billing catalogue. Product ids must match Play Console exactly. Contents are fixed (no random rewards). price_hint_usd is only for docs and debug builds: the real localized price always comes from Google Play.

remove_ads.name: Remove Ads
remove_ads.desc: No ads ever again. Ad bonuses (extra Rocky, spins, double coins) are granted instantly.

gem_crate.name: Gem Crate
gem_crate.desc: 400 gems for premium skins and trails.

hellfire_crate.name: Hellfire Crate
hellfire_crate.desc: 3 Hellfire strikes. Rains fire boulders and destroys every enemy structure. Purchase only.

shop.pending_note: Payment pending. Your reward arrives as soon as Google Play confirms it.

Art, sound and levels: made for Castle Smashers

welcome_mail.title: Welcome, Commander!
welcome_mail.body: The kingdom needs you. Here is a gift to start your siege.

ui._doc: Menu feel: finger-drag scrolling of card lists (DragScroll).

friendly_fire._doc: Our own blasts, flames and heroes that land short hurt the Vanguard (Level.hurt_soldiers).

flood._doc: Sluice gate + flood wave (src/game/flood.gd). push_accel px/s^2 downstream, buoyancy = 1/density capped, guards in the water drown at drown_dps (archer hp 30).

wizard_workshop.name: Master Orin
wizard_workshop.title: MASTER ORIN’S SIEGE WORKSHOP
wizard_workshop.intro: I forge the engines. Heroes master their gifts in battle, not through a shop.
wizard_workshop.locked_line: Complete Level %d and I will reveal this engine.
wizard_workshop.available_line: Level requirement met. Pay the forge cost to make this engine yours.
wizard_workshop.owned_line: Owned. Choose a meaningful upgrade, Commander.

hellfire._doc: Paid Hellfire strike (Level._hellfire_strike): one fire boulder per block, then every guard falls and the level is won.
